risks.title: Dependence on a single funder
risks.cause: A large share of research funding comes from one sponsor or program
risks.event: that sponsor's priorities or budget change
risks.consequence: programs lose support faster than they can be wound down or funded again

risks.title: Change to indirect cost recovery
risks.cause: Sponsors revise what overhead they will pay
risks.event: recovery falls well below the cost of supporting research
risks.consequence: shared services and facilities are cut or run at a loss

risks.title: A leading program loses its edge
risks.cause: Investment follows established strengths while the field moves
risks.event: a leading program falls behind its peers
risks.consequence: recruitment, funding, and standing decline together

risks.title: Breakdown of a major affiliation
risks.cause: Shared governance with a partner institution rests on agreements that have aged
risks.event: the partner changes strategy or leadership and the arrangement is contested
risks.consequence: shared programs, appointments, and facilities are disrupted

risks.title: Public controversy over research or conduct
risks.cause: Work or behavior that some will object to is not anticipated
risks.event: it becomes a public story before the organization has responded
risks.consequence: trust among participants, donors, and partners is damaged

risks.title: Research misconduct goes undetected
risks.cause: Pressure to publish, and supervision that varies from lab to lab
risks.event: fabricated, falsified, or plagiarized work is published
risks.consequence: retractions, sanctions from sponsors, and lasting harm to reputations

risks.title: Results that cannot be supported
risks.cause: Laboratory records are kept inconsistently and leave with people
risks.event: published results cannot be reproduced or supported when questioned
risks.consequence: corrections or retractions, and loss of confidence in the lab's work

risks.title: Research outside its approved protocol
risks.cause: Amendments, renewals, and consent versions are tracked by hand
risks.event: participants are enrolled or procedures carried out without current approval
risks.consequence: participants are put at risk, data cannot be used, and the study may be suspended

risks.title: Identifiable participant data disclosed
risks.cause: Research data is copied, shared, and analyzed outside managed systems
risks.event: identifiable information reaches someone not entitled to it
risks.consequence: harm to participants, a duty to notify, and loss of trust in the organization's research

risks.title: Animal welfare failure
risks.cause: Environmental controls or staffing in an animal facility fail out of hours
risks.event: animals suffer or die
risks.consequence: loss of research, regulatory findings, and public concern

risks.title: Loss of irreplaceable specimens
risks.cause: Freezers, the supply of liquid nitrogen, or their monitoring fail
risks.event: stored specimens thaw before anyone responds
risks.consequence: years of collection are lost and the studies that depend on them cannot be completed

risks.title: Loss of research data
risks.cause: Data sits on instruments, laptops, and portable drives without managed backup
risks.event: a device fails, is lost, or is encrypted by an attacker
risks.consequence: results cannot be reproduced and funded work must be repeated or abandoned

risks.title: Undisclosed outside support or affiliation
risks.cause: Researchers are unsure what must be disclosed, and nobody checks
risks.event: a sponsor finds support, an appointment, or a conflict that was not reported
risks.consequence: repayment, loss of awards, and exclusion of people or the organization from funding

risks.title: Controlled items shared without authorization
risks.cause: Controlled technology and information are not identified at the start of a project
risks.event: they are shared with a person or place the law restricts
risks.consequence: penalties, loss of privileges, and personal liability

risks.title: Medication error
risks.cause: Products that look alike, interruptions, and transcription by hand
risks.event: a patient receives the wrong drug or dose
risks.consequence: harm to the patient and loss of confidence in the service

risks.title: Wrong patient or wrong procedure
risks.cause: Identity is confirmed inconsistently at handoffs
risks.event: a test, treatment, or specimen is attributed to the wrong person
risks.consequence: harm, repeated procedures, and results that cannot be relied on

risks.title: Infection acquired during care
risks.cause: Lapses in hygiene, cleaning, or isolation among vulnerable patients
risks.event: an infection spreads within a clinical area
risks.consequence: serious harm to patients and closure of the area

risks.title: Serious deviation in a clinical trial
risks.cause: Complex protocols and stretched study staff
risks.event: eligibility, dosing, or safety reporting departs from the protocol
risks.consequence: participants are put at risk and the trial's data may be rejected

risks.title: Clinical systems unavailable during care
risks.cause: Care depends on electronic records and connected devices
risks.event: they are unavailable for hours and working without them has not been practiced
risks.consequence: care is delayed and errors become more likely

risks.title: A patient's decline is missed
risks.cause: Monitoring and escalation depend on individual vigilance
risks.event: a patient's deterioration is noticed or acted on late
risks.consequence: avoidable harm or death

risks.title: Breach of protected health information
risks.cause: Health information is held in many systems and handled by many people
risks.event: it is lost, stolen, or seen by someone with no need to
risks.consequence: harm to individuals, notification to them and to regulators, and penalties

risks.title: Access kept after a person leaves or changes role
risks.cause: Access is granted readily and removed only when someone remembers
risks.event: a former or reassigned person still reaches sensitive systems
risks.consequence: unauthorized use or disclosure that the organization must answer for

risks.title: Terms of an award not met
risks.cause: Each award has its own conditions, known mainly to its investigator
risks.event: a condition on reporting, data sharing, or spending is missed
risks.consequence: funds are withheld or repaid and future applications are prejudiced

risks.title: Data used outside its agreement
risks.cause: Data received under an agreement is passed between projects and people
risks.event: it is used, combined, or shared in a way the agreement forbids
risks.consequence: the provider withdraws the data and declines to share again

risks.title: Loss of a license or accreditation
risks.cause: Standards change, and evidence of meeting them is assembled only before a visit
risks.event: an inspection finds serious gaps
risks.consequence: a service is suspended and its work must stop or move

risks.title: Harassment or retaliation not addressed
risks.cause: People doubt that reporting is safe or leads anywhere
risks.event: serious conduct continues after it could have been stopped
risks.consequence: harm to individuals, legal action, and loss of talent

risks.title: Ransomware
risks.cause: Phishing, unpatched systems, and broad access rights
risks.event: an attacker encrypts systems and data across the network
risks.consequence: research and care stop for days or weeks, and data may be lost or published

risks.title: Compromised account
risks.cause: Passwords are reused and some access lacks a second factor
risks.event: an attacker signs in as a member of staff
risks.consequence: information is stolen, and the account is used to reach further

risks.title: Unsupported systems in use
risks.cause: Instruments and applications outlive the software they run on
risks.event: a known weakness is exploited, or the system fails beyond repair
risks.consequence: the work that depends on it stops, and the weakness reaches other systems

risks.title: A change breaks a critical system
risks.cause: Changes are made under time pressure with limited testing
risks.event: an update or a change of configuration takes a critical system out of service
risks.consequence: work stops until it is undone, and data may be corrupted

risks.title: Backups cannot be restored
risks.cause: Backups run unattended and restores are rarely tested
risks.event: data must be restored and the backup is incomplete or unusable
risks.consequence: permanent loss of data the organization believed was safe

risks.title: Data exposed by misconfiguration
risks.cause: Cloud storage and sharing are set up by people outside central teams
risks.event: sensitive data is left open to the internet or to everyone in the organization
risks.consequence: disclosure that may go unnoticed for months

risks.title: Unreviewed use of AI with sensitive data
risks.cause: AI tools are easy to adopt without anyone's approval
risks.event: sensitive or regulated data is entered into a tool with no agreement covering it
risks.consequence: data is disclosed, and results are relied on that nobody has checked

risks.title: Sign-in service unavailable
risks.cause: Every system depends on one identity service
risks.event: it fails or is locked by an attacker
risks.consequence: nobody can work until it is restored

risks.title: Extended loss of power
risks.cause: Backup generation is sized and tested for short outages
risks.event: power is lost for longer than the backup can carry
risks.consequence: specimens, animals, experiments, and systems are lost

risks.title: Loss of environmental control
risks.cause: Ventilation and cooling serve laboratories, animal rooms, and data rooms with little to spare
risks.event: a plant failure takes temperature or air handling out of range
risks.consequence: work stops, materials are lost, and spaces become unsafe

risks.title: Failure of a critical instrument
risks.cause: A core service depends on one instrument with a long repair time
risks.event: it fails with no alternative arranged
risks.consequence: many groups' work waits for weeks

risks.title: Exposure to a hazardous agent
risks.cause: Hazardous biological, chemical, or radioactive materials are handled daily
risks.event: a spill, release, or sharps injury exposes someone
risks.consequence: injury or illness, regulatory findings, and suspension of the work

risks.title: Fire or flood in a research building
risks.cause: Laboratories hold flammable materials and water-cooled equipment
risks.event: a fire or major leak damages a building
risks.consequence: people are endangered, and space, equipment, and materials are lost for months

risks.title: Regional disaster
risks.cause: The organization is concentrated in one place
risks.event: an earthquake, storm, or epidemic closes it for an extended period
risks.consequence: research and care are interrupted well beyond what plans assume

risks.title: Loss of a key person
risks.cause: Essential knowledge or relationships rest with one person
risks.event: they leave or are suddenly unavailable
risks.consequence: a program, service, or system cannot continue as it was

risks.title: Unable to recruit or keep skilled staff
risks.cause: Pay and career paths lag behind competing employers
risks.event: critical roles stay vacant or turn over repeatedly
risks.consequence: services degrade and the staff who remain are overloaded

risks.title: Serious workplace injury
risks.cause: Laboratory, clinical, and facilities work carries physical hazards
risks.event: someone is seriously injured at work
risks.consequence: harm to the person, an investigation, and loss of confidence among colleagues

risks.title: Sustained overload
risks.cause: Demands rise faster than staffing
risks.event: exhaustion becomes widespread in a team
risks.consequence: errors, absence, and departures increase together

risks.title: Required training not completed
risks.cause: Training requirements multiply and are tracked in several places
risks.event: people do work they are not currently trained or authorized for
risks.consequence: avoidable incidents, and findings at inspection

risks.title: Unallowable costs charged to an award
risks.cause: Charges are approved by people unfamiliar with each sponsor's rules
risks.event: costs the sponsor does not allow are charged and certified
risks.consequence: repayment, audit findings, and closer scrutiny of every award

risks.title: Effort not certified accurately
risks.cause: Effort is certified after the fact by busy investigators
risks.event: salary charged to awards does not match the work done
risks.consequence: repayment, and findings that reach across the organization

risks.title: Subrecipient not monitored
risks.cause: Funds pass to partner organizations whose controls are unknown
risks.event: a subrecipient misspends the funds or cannot account for them
risks.consequence: the organization must repay them and answer for the failure

risks.title: Payment fraud
risks.cause: Requests to change bank details are accepted by email
risks.event: a payment is sent to an impostor
risks.consequence: the money is lost and rarely recovered

risks.title: Misuse of purchasing authority
risks.cause: Many people can buy with little review
risks.event: personal or improper purchases are made over time
risks.consequence: loss of funds, and of confidence in the organization's stewardship

risks.title: Operating shortfall
risks.cause: Costs are committed years ahead while income is awarded year by year
risks.event: income falls well short of plan
risks.consequence: reserves are drawn down and programs are cut at short notice

risks.title: Gift used against its terms
risks.cause: Restrictions on gifts are recorded at the time and forgotten later
risks.event: a restricted gift is spent on something else
risks.consequence: the donor's trust is lost and the gift may have to be restored

risks.title: Dependence on a single supplier
risks.cause: A critical material, reagent, or service has one source
risks.event: the supplier fails, is acquired, or cannot deliver
risks.consequence: the work that depends on it stops until another source is found and qualified

risks.title: A hosted service is unavailable
risks.cause: A critical system is run entirely by a supplier
risks.event: the supplier has a prolonged outage or ends the service
risks.consequence: the organization cannot work and cannot fix it

risks.title: A supplier discloses the organization's information
risks.cause: Sensitive information is held by suppliers whose safeguards are taken on trust
risks.event: the supplier is breached or misuses the information
risks.consequence: the organization must notify those affected and answer for a failure it could not see

risks.title: Regulated information shared without an agreement
risks.cause: Services are bought and data shared before anyone checks what agreement is needed
risks.event: protected information is held by a party with no agreement covering it
risks.consequence: a violation exists from the first day, whether or not anything goes wrong

risks.title: A collaborator does not deliver
risks.cause: A study depends on work at another institution
risks.event: the collaborator falls behind, loses staff, or withdraws
risks.consequence: the study is delayed or cannot be completed as funded
